title: fix: send no token limit on the hidden search step
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The hidden search step on the Vercel search + JSON route, which falls back to google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:search, no longer sends max_tokens; it previously forced a minimum of 2048. A caller's max_tokens or max_completion_tokens now limits only the final answer, not the search step. An empty search answer still returns 502.
